scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Sealed in the underground
of the Prontera Castle...
I didn't expect it to be this huge...
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
被封印在普隆德拉王宫的地下...
没想到这里竟然这么大...

scripts.text:
[Iris]
What on earth is there inside?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
里面到底有什么东西？

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
I don't know. Let's investigate the inside, first.
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
不知道。先进去调查一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
This...this must be...
Ymir's Heart!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
这...这一定是...
尤弥尔之心！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
This...
This is Ymir's Heart...
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
这...
这是尤弥尔之心...

scripts.text: ~Rumbling~
scripts.translation: ~轰隆声~

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Why is this place shaking?!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
为什么这里在震动？！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
~Grunts~ They must've started attacking this place, too.
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
~低吼~ 看来他们也开始进攻这里了。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
~Grins~ Delighted to see you all.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
~冷笑~ 很高兴见到各位。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
!!
You've got to be kidding me!
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
!!
你开什么玩笑！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
From this moment on, we the Immortal Legion by Lord Valkyrie Himelmez
will take over here.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
从这一刻起，瓦尔基里希梅尔梅兹大人的不朽军团将接管此地。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
What? How dare you!
I'm game. Bring it on!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
什么？竟敢如此！
我奉陪到底。来吧！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
~Grins~ Do I look like I have the time to deal with a petty thing like you, human?
But, out of pure mercy, I'll let you taste the fearful power of the Immortal Legion just a little bit.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
~冷笑~ 我哪有时间理会你这种小人物，人类？
不过，出于纯粹的怜悯，我会让你稍微尝尝不朽军团那令人恐惧的力量。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
~Grunts~ When did all the legionnaires get here?
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
~低吼~ 军团士兵是什么时候赶到这里的？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
~Chuckles~ I think you're not that bad for a human.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
~轻笑~ 作为人类，你还算不错。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
But do you think you can get away from this, again? Wake up, my underlings!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
但你觉得你还能再次逃脱吗？醒来吧，我的部下们！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
What...what's up with this monster?!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
这...这怪物是怎么回事？！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Ah...
I'll let you in on me before I go.
I'm Bijou.
I'm the adjutant to Lord Valkyrie Himelmez.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
啊...
在我离开之前，告诉你我的名字。
我是碧珠。
我是瓦尔基里希梅尔梅兹大人的副官。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
~Groans~
No Valkyrie's subordinates ever disappointed me and neither did you.
Ymir's Heart is a huge energy source. For what do you want to use it anyway?
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
~呻吟~
瓦尔基里的部下从未让我失望，你也不例外。
尤弥尔之心是巨大的能量源。你们打算用它做什么？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
......
You don't need to know. You're going to be wiped out soon anyway.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
......
你不需要知道。反正你马上就要被消灭了。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
I don't think you'd use it for any good cause.
I'll stop Bijou from taking Ymir's Heart. You go ahead and take care of that huge monster!
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
我不认为你会把它用于什么正义的事业。
我会阻止碧珠夺取尤弥尔之心。你去对付那只巨大的魔物吧！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Was that it...? Has it gone now?
So what's left now is...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
结束了吗...？它走了吗？
那么现在剩下的是...

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Me...I'm the only one left...
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
我...我是唯一剩下的了...

scripts.text:
[Iris]
What?!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
什么？！

scripts.text: ~POW!~

[Iris]
Aaarrghhh---!!!

[Bijou]
I must say it was rather unexpected. ~Chuckles~
I didn't expect anyone to defeat Amdarais that I spent three good years to complete.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
不得不说，这出乎我的意料。~轻笑~
我没想到会有人能击败我花了整整三年才完成的暗答莱尸。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
You will pay
for ruining my three-year efforts!!
Slowly...
And horribly painfully...!!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
我要让你为毁掉我三年的心血付出代价！！
慢慢地...
让你痛苦万分...！！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
~Groans~ I can't believe nothing seems to work!
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
~呻吟~ 我简直不敢相信，什么都没用！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
~Chuckles~
I'll let you taste what despair feels like.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
~轻笑~
我要让你尝尝绝望的滋味。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Frost Diver!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
冰刺！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
~Groans~
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
~呻吟~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
How does it feel? Painful, eh?
You must become paralyzed by now.
...But don't expect me to kill you that easily...
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
感觉如何？很痛吧？
你现在应该已经瘫痪了。
...但别指望我会轻易杀了你...

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
I should take care of this downright annoying cleric gal first.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
我应该先解决这个烦人的牧师女孩。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
I...Iris!!
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
我...艾莉丝！！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Sarah...?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
莎拉...？

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
So this is it...
This is the underground of Prontera Castle.
The place where the first Ymir's Heart is sealed.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
原来如此...
这里是普隆德拉王宫的地下。
第一颗尤弥尔之心被封印的地方。

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
And that must be...
Ymir's Heart...
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
那一定是...
尤弥尔之心...

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
What brought you all the way up here?
Sarah Irine.
I didn't expect you would show up here.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
你们怎么会跑到这里来？
莎拉·伊琳。
我没料到你会出现在这里。

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
What do you think you're doing here, Bijou?
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
碧珠，你在这里干什么？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Yes, I was in the middle of taking care of the annoying bugs.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
是的，我正准备处理那些烦人的虫子。

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
What kind of answer is that, Bijou?
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
碧珠，这是什么回答？

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
My question was: what are you still doing here, totally goofing off, and, why didn't you break any sealing off of Ymir's Heart?
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
我的意思是：你为什么还在这里磨蹭，而且，为什么尤弥尔之心的封印没有被解除？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Well, that's uh...I did break the 1st seal, though.
This place will be cleaned up in no time. There is nothing for you to worry about, Sarah.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
嗯，那个...我已经解除了第一道封印。
这里很快就会清理干净。莎拉，你不用担心。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Trust me and consider it done. Please be yourself as proud Valkyrie.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
相信我，事情已经办妥了。请保持你作为瓦尔基里的骄傲。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
(~Scoffs~ What an uptight, pathetic Valkyrie she is! I can't believe a greenhorn like you are treated the same as Himelmez. That is so unfair.)
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
（~哼~ 真是个死板又可怜的瓦尔基里！真不敢相信像你这样的新手，竟然和希梅尔梅兹受到同等待遇。这也太不公平了。）

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
You must be out of your mind, Bijou...There is no Himelmez here.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
碧珠，你一定是疯了...这里根本没有希梅尔梅兹。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
....~Gasps~
I'm out of breath!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
....~倒吸一口凉气~
我喘不过气了！

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
You'd better keep your mouth shut!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
你最好闭嘴！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
~Coughs~
~Keeps coughing~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
~咳嗽~
~一直咳嗽~

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
I can certainly do without a subordinate who wastes time for this kind of petty job.
Let me take that Ymir's Heart...myself.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
我确实不需要一个在这种琐碎工作上浪费时间的下属。
让我亲自去拿那颗尤弥尔之心...

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
(She is Valkyrie, indeed. Oh, what can you do about that?)
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
（她确实是瓦尔基里。唉，你能怎么办呢？）

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
The time is right!
Frost Diver!
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
时机到了！
冰霜潜行者！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
What did you say?!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
你说什么？！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Whoa...That was a close; call.
How could this happen?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
哇...好险。
怎么会发生这种事？

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
This magic...
This must be high-level magic as I expected. It's pretty tough to cast it.
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
这个魔法...
正如我所料，这是高阶魔法。施放起来相当困难。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
(What is this?! Did she just master the magic that I used on her?)
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
（这是什么？她刚才掌握了我对她使用的魔法吗？）

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Iris! This is a healing potion.
Drink it and you'll come to your senses.
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
艾莉丝！这是一瓶治疗药水。
喝下去，你就会恢复神智。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
~Muffled sound~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
~含糊不清的声音~

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Oh, you woke up now?
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
哦，你醒了？

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Umm....
~Vomiting sound~
Yuck! Is this bitter!
What the heck is this?!
What did you give to me?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
唔...
~呕吐声~
好苦！这是什么味道！
你对我做了什么？！
你给了我喝什么？

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
So you woke up, Iris.
I'm so relieved.
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
艾莉丝，你终于醒了。
我松了一口气。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
~Sighs~ By the way, Fenrir!
What about Ymir's Heart?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
~叹气~ 对了，芬里尔！
关于“尤弥尔之心”的事呢？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
(...Fenrir? I thought too much about Ymir's Heart and totally forgot about her. If my guess is right, she must be...!)
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
（...芬里尔？我因为太在意“尤弥尔之心”而完全忘了她。如果我的猜测没错，她应该是...！）

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
~Exhales~ I see. That's right.
That beast's blood flowing through your body...That was the answer!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
~呼气~ 我明白了。没错。
流淌在你体内的野兽之血...那就是答案！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Then, let me serve you the right way! ~Chuckles~
I didn't expect to see the hero from a thousand years ago!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
那么，让我好好招待你吧！~轻笑~
没想到能见到千年前的英雄！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Die!!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
去死吧！！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
...Be careful. She's about to attack!
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
...小心。她要攻击了！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
~Grunts~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
~呻吟声~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
~Evil laughter~ Die!
Clerics deserve to die!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
~邪恶的笑声~ 去死吧！
牧师这种职业就该死！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Iris!!
No! Stop!!
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
艾莉丝！！
不！住手！！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
~Chuckles~
So you're looking for a partner, eh?
Good idea, but...I think it's too late.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
~轻笑~
原来你在找同伴啊？
主意不错，但是...我觉得已经太迟了。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Because...
This will be the final, fatal blow to you. Wahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
因为...
这将是对你的最后一击，也是致命一击。哇哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
....~Sighs~
Huh?...In my stomach...
This knife...
Sa...Sarah...? How?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
....~叹气~
咦？...我的肚子里...
这把刀...
莎...莎拉...？怎么会？

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
Is that all you want to say?
Don't worry. I'll let Himelmez know of your brave contribution. Don't blame me, Bijou.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
你就只想说这些吗？
别担心。我会告诉希梅尔梅兹你的英勇贡献。别怪我，碧珠。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Why...? Tell me why!
...That...that little chick...Was that it? Because she's your sister? Was that it? Tell me, Sarah!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
为什么...？告诉我为什么！
...那个...那个小丫头...是因为她是你的妹妹吗？是因为这个吗？告诉我，莎拉！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
~Groans~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
~呻吟声~

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
......
Your soul has been set free, Bijou.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
......
你的灵魂已经得到解放了，碧珠。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
(Did she save me...?)
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
（是她救了我...吗？）

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Sarah...
It's Sarah, right?
People say we parted when we were little...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
莎拉...
是你吗，莎拉？
听说我们小时候就分开了...

scripts.text:
[Iris]
...So what's your plan, huh? Why...why did you save me?!
Don't you ever think this will ever change my belief! I will never, ever forgive you!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
...那你打算怎么办？为什么...为什么要救我？！
别以为这样就能改变我的信念！我永远不会，永远不会原谅你！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Mom...Dad...Every people in our town. I'm going to revenge!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
妈妈...爸爸...还有我们城镇里的所有人。我要复仇！

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
Shut that mouth!
Don't be a drama queen as if you're the only victim here.
They just paid the price for what they sinned. The sin that they committed by killing my mother 12 years ago.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
闭嘴！
别把自己当成唯一的受害者，像个戏精一样。
他们只是为他们的罪行付出了代价。十二年前，他们杀害了我母亲的罪行。

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
Do you want me to tell you the truth? Those 'loved ones' you're incessantly talking about...Our great elder and the people in our town were actually...
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
你想听真话吗？那些你口中不停念叨的“亲人”...我们伟大的长老和城镇里的人，其实是...

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
......
Stop it...
Ymir's Heart comes first, no matter what.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
......
住口...
无论如何，尤弥尔之心才是最重要的。

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
Mark my word.
I didn't let you live.
I will let you die soon.
I make sure you no longer see the light of day the next time when we meet.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
听好了。
我没让你死。
我会让你很快去死。
下次见面，我保证你再也见不到阳光。

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
Don't you ever let anyone kill you until then, Iris.
I'd better bid farewell for today, then.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
在那之前，艾莉丝，千万别让别人杀了你。
那么，今天就到此为止吧。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
~Grunts~ That Valkyrie destroyed the ceiling when taking Ymir's Heart!
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
~低吼~ 那个瓦尔基里在夺取尤弥尔之心时把天花板都砸坏了！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
We'd better get out of here, too! This place is too dangerous!
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
我们也得赶紧离开这里！这地方太危险了！
